style_when: the article is a purely conceptual synthesis or policy dilemma where no physical facility, machine, or supply chain exists, and an elegant abstract paper silhouette states the idea. Never reach for paper collage when the story describes physical manufacturing, freight, energy, hardware, or heavy infrastructure — use cinematic still or telephoto industry instead
prompt: Minimalist editorial cut-paper collage. Two stylized cut-out object silhouettes—a rigid mechanical tool form cleanly separating from a stacked workflow dossier shape—layered deliberately on a real flat surface. Hand-torn rag paper with visible fiber, physical cast shadows under each crisp layer, one raking directional light throwing long shadows. Muted modern editorial palette of slate blue and soft cream, crisp clean edges, generous editorial negative space, subtle halftone newsprint texture.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, typography, watermarks, UI, printed text, numbers
rationale: The article describes a purely conceptual software standard and an architectural stack split, which is elegantly represented through a minimalist paper collage visualizing the separation of two distinct logical layers.

core_thesis: The MCP skills extension officially splits the AI agent stack into two distinct layers: tools and standardized processes.
core_conflict: Monolithic agent execution vs cleanly separated, standardized network resources.
